description: Synthetic identity alert: unusual sign-in from unfamiliar network to vendor-linked support account
Employee forwards suspect support-portal verification message to internal helpdesk
Synthetic support-app audit shows 41 ticket records read by same account in nine minutes
Incident commander marks SEV-2 provisional; access pattern raises concern but exfiltration is not proven
Response team proposes revoke vendor-linked tokens and suspend associated access pending approval
SOC queues retention of identity audit and ticket access logs; hash/export provenance not yet verified
Vendor security contact requested to confirm sign-in source and session revocation scope
Vendor has not supplied authoritative export audit or full session history
Privacy lead asked to assess personal-data exposure; only ticket-read metadata is available
Service restoration deferred pending token invalidation proof and verified reduced privileges
Initial exercise improvement backlog drafted; closure and validation remain open
